title: A weekly growth loop · a sketch for Privy by Juan Pablo García
desc: One loop a week from Privy's investor activity data to metro pages, short video, outbound and trials.
h1: One loop a week from Privy's data to new trials
lede: The role asks for an always on growth engine built with Claude, with content from your data, SEO and AEO, email journeys and outbound. You already have the input nobody else can copy, live investor activity by market. This is the loop I would ship in the first two weeks and then improve every week after.
stage: From this week's investor activity to tracked trials

flow.label: Diagram of a weekly growth loop from market data to content, outbound, HubSpot and attribution

steps.t: Start from what only Privy has
steps.d: Investor purchases and flips by zip code. Nobody else can publish this, which is what makes it rank and get quoted.
A small job ranks metros by what changed this week. More flips, shorter holds, or a new buyer group moving in.

Claude drafts a metro page with structured data so search and answer engines can cite it, plus a 60 second video script. Numbers are checked against the data and a person approves before anything goes live.

steps.t: Reach the people in that market
steps.d: Clay finds agents and investors active in those zips. Each email opens with a number from their own market, not a template line.
Signups from pages, video and email enter HubSpot tagged with the metro and the asset that brought them.
Every trial ties back to a metro and an asset. Next week's picks lean toward what converted, not what got clicks.
Same loop, one new system every week or two. A new channel, a new page type or a better hook, each judged on trials.
